description: Header file defining the VaapiVideoDecodeAccelerator class, which provides hardware-accelerated video decoding support on Intel systems using VA-API. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and internal state management for decoding, surface handling, and client interaction.

classes.name: VaapiVideoDecodeAccelerator
classes.description: Provides hardware-accelerated video decoding on Intel systems via VA-API, managing decoding tasks, surfaces, and client interactions.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with configuration and client.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Queues a bitstream buffer for decoding.

methods.name: ReusePictureBuffer
methods.description: Reuses a picture buffer after output.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the decoder, outputting all pending frames.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the decoder instance.

methods.name: TryToSetupDecodeOnSeparateSequence
methods.description: Attempts to set up decoding on a separate sequence.

methods.name: CreateSurface
methods.description: Creates a new VA surface for decoding.

methods.name: SurfaceReady
methods.description: Called when a VA surface is ready for use.

methods.name: OnMemoryDump
methods.description: Provides memory dump information for profiling.
